name: llm-checker
description: Pick a local LLM that fits this machine's VRAM, and see which local runtimes are installed.

pick-model.description: Recommend a local model that fits this machine's VRAM

runtime-check.description: Show which local LLM runtimes are installed and usable

interface.shortDescription: Find which local models this machine can actually run.
interface.longDescription: Reads the real GPU, VRAM budget and installed runtimes with the llm-checker CLI, then ranks local models by what fits and how well they score on public benchmarks. Distinguishes a measured benchmark from a size-based estimate so a recommendation is never presented as more certain than it is. Read-only: it never downloads a model, starts a server, or changes runtime configuration.
defaultPrompt: Which local model can my machine run?
What is the best local coding model for this GPU?
Will a 14B model fit in my VRAM?
Which local LLM runtimes do I have installed?
